concerns.text: The plan uses a paired two‑sided t‑test (α = 0.05) comparing model predictions to DFT values and treats a p‑value > 0.05 as a success criterion. Failing to reject the null hypothesis does not demonstrate predictive accuracy; with limited test‑set size the test may be under‑powered, leading to false acceptance. The methodology should rely on confidence intervals (e.g., the bootstrap RMSE CI) or predefined error thresholds rather than interpreting a non‑significant t‑test as evidence of model validity.
